name: What is the difference between task, ambient, and accent lighting for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between task, ambient, and accent lighting for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Task lighting provides focused illumination for specific activities, like vanity lights above a mirror for grooming. Ambient lighting offers overall general illumination for the room, often achieved with recessed or ceiling fixtures. Accent lighting highlights architectural features or decorative elements, creating visual interest. A well-designed bathroom typically incorporates a combination of all three for optimal functionality and aesthetics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Task lighting targets activities (vanity), ambient lighting provides general room illumination (recessed), and accent lighting highlights features.
